requirements.evidence: IndexerOptions.confirmations is optional. createIndexer passes opts.confirmations into the LogCursor constructor. The SDK uses opts.confirmations ?? 0n, so an omitted value stays 0n.

Startup sets confirmations to 3n when chain.mode is arc and 0n otherwise. ApiChain.mode is only arc or simulated, so the other arm is simulation. cursorStart remains INDEX_FROM_BLOCK or 0. maxRange stays unset.

With confirmations 3n, cursorStart 0n, head 10, and an empty getLogs, the cursor test saves last_block 7 and requests toBlock 7. Blocks 8 through 10 stay unread. After the provider catches up and head is 13, the same indexer reads ProofAccepted and KeyReleased and saves 10, which is head minus 3. Arc startup supplies that 3n.

The arc chain-id check still runs before getBlockNumber and getLogs, including when confirmations is set. One window remains the SDK default of 10000 blocks: head 20000, confirmations 3n, and maxWindowsPerTick 1 read through block 9999. Events and the cursor still commit in one transaction. A thrown getLogs leaves both tables empty. Nothing deletes or rewinds index_cursor. LogCursor does not save when the stored position is already past head minus confirmations.
